facts.business: Seshsayee Paper and Boards Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper boards in India and internationally, and also trades in notebooks, paper, and petroleum products.

segments.name: Paper and Paper Boards - Rest of the World

facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the financial year were entered into with prior approval of the Audit Committee. The Company has a policy on related party transactions and details are disclosed in Form AOC-2 (Annexure-IV) and in the notes to financial statements as per Ind AS-24.
